episode_title: Sydney and Melbourne Property Has Frozen Up. What Happened?

real_qa.q: What are the worst-performing suburbs for mortgage arrears in Australia?
real_qa.r: Pakenham, Victoria leads with arrears of 2.88%, followed by Constitution Hill in the Parramatta area of New South Wales at 2.42%, Point Cook at 2.4%, and Borkham Hills at 2.26%. The RBA is warning that the number of mortgages in negative equity could jump fivefold, with outer suburban areas running at three times the national average.

real_qa.q: How much have Sydney house prices increased over 70 years?
real_qa.r: Sydney house prices have risen from $19.55 in 1965 to $1.76 million today, representing a 323-fold increase over seven decades. The market has now slipped across the country with the top end falling 10 to 15 percent, while some properties have lost almost nine million dollars in five years.

real_qa.q: What is the impact of the 5% deposit scheme on first-time homebuyers in Australia?
real_qa.r: Young Australians who rushed into the property market using the Labor government's 5% deposit scheme are now watching their entire savings wiped out. A worked example shows a couple who bought a $900,000 Sydney apartment with $45,000 down, which is now worth $836,000 after Sydney's 7.1% fall, leaving them $19,000 underwater with their deposit gone.
real_qa.requete: 5% deposit scheme Australia first home buyers

real_qa.q: What happened to Sydney and Melbourne property listings according to REA Group?
real_qa.r: Sydney and Melbourne listings fell 16% in the three months to September compared to the same period last year, a massive swing from the plus 8% the quarter before. Meanwhile, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide listings rose 17%, showing a genuine two-speed market where sellers are striking in the southeast while stock is flooding into mid-sized capitals.

real_qa.q: How much have variable mortgage repayments increased for property investors since February?
real_qa.r: Variable mortgage repayments for property investors have increased by approximately 11% since February, while rents in the same period rose only 1.8%. This gap is adding pressure on investors given the banking regulator's mortgage serviceability buffer that compels lenders to assess repayment ability at an interest rate 3% above the actual rate.

real_qa.q: How many months have national dwelling values declined in Australia?
real_qa.r: National dwelling values have declined for five straight months. Sydney has fallen 7.1%, Melbourne is down 6.5%, and even Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide markets are now moving backwards. Median property is now sitting on the market for 38 days, the longest stretch since October 2022.
